title: expression gate: a date-arithmetic verdict in a flow condition still says the value "silently evaluates to null", though the run fails
body:
domain:server#6 · os-support-ai · session_01WGufzibcN9oHa8kDbTTnL5

Filing gate: ① the gate tells an author something untrue about run time, at a named location. Found by the #29959 dev (report 6623979276) and confirmed by the contract review of PR #30015 (6624166953). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Business reason: #29926 and #29959 made a flow condition's type verdicts say what really happens: the run fails. The date-arithmetic verdict was left out. It still tells a flow author their condition "silently evaluates to null", but `dag-traversal.ts` `evaluateCondition` throws on a non-`ok` evaluation for every flow. The author is told the flow will carry on when it will not.
Reader who acts: `domain:server`, `packages/formula/src/validate.ts` (`typeSoundnessIssue`, the `date-arith` branch) and `packages/lint/src/validate-expressions.ts` (the flow sites' outcome).
Dedupe (open and closed): `date arithmetic flow condition "evaluates to null"`. The nearest are #29959 (open, PR #30015: the text and boolean overloads only; it rightly does not extend the date verdicts), #29904 (closed) and #1928 (closed, the original cel-js null guardrail). None covers the date branch's sentence on flow sites. **New.**

## What happens

The `date-arith` branch of `typeSoundnessIssue` serves one sentence, "silently evaluates to null", whatever the scope and outcome. On a flow condition (start, edge, decision) the run fails instead.

## What to fix

Give the date branch the same per-site outcome the text and boolean overloads get since PR #29953 / PR #30015: the run-fails wording (and grading) on record-triggered flows, and the run-may-fail wording elsewhere. Keep the `record`-scoped validation-rule sentence where it is true. Measure first, after PR #30015 lands, because it moves the same code. Pins: one per flow site, plus a record-scoped control. Ablate once.
